landing.hero.title: SMART PETS
landing.hero.sub: Dogs (and later cats) with judgment, personality, genetics and a bond that grows. A fan-made concept for Minecraft Java.
landing.hero.stage: Honest status: this is a concept in pre-alpha. There is no playable build and nothing to download yet. Everything on this page is a sketch of the idea.
landing.hero.art: Pixel art scene: a dog sits on a row of grass blocks while the sun and the moon take turns crossing the sky. At night the dog sleeps and tiny Zs float up.
landing.problem.title: Why a smarter pet?
landing.problem.sub: What tends to bug players about the vanilla wolf, and what this project wants to change.
landing.problem.vanilla.title: The vanilla wolf
landing.problem.vanilla.1: Walks into lava or off a cliff
landing.problem.vanilla.2: Attacks almost anything, even your friends
landing.problem.vanilla.4: Teleports to you instead of walking to you
landing.problem.vanilla.5: Not much to do together in singleplayer
landing.problem.idea.title: The Smart Pets idea
landing.problem.idea.1: Judgment: it backs away from lava, cliffs and creepers
landing.problem.idea.2: Safe by design: it never attacks you or your allies
landing.problem.idea.3: A bond that grows: do things together and it trusts you more
landing.problem.idea.4: No teleporting: it follows you on its own four legs
landing.problem.idea.5: A real individual: no two dogs are alike
landing.problem.note: These are design goals, not features you can play today.
landing.features.title: What the dog is meant to do
landing.features.sub: Everything below is planned. Nothing is playable yet.
landing.feat.judgment.title: Judgment
landing.feat.judgment.text: It avoids lava, cliffs and creepers about to blow, and it never attacks you or your allies. It only goes after what you mark.
landing.feat.genes.title: Personality and genetics
landing.feat.genes.text: Every dog is different. Traits are inherited, litters are usually 3 to 5 puppies, and each coat is pixel art mixed from the parents.
landing.feat.cues.title: Teach it your words
landing.feat.cues.text: A cue can be your voice, a chat word or a key, in any language. Say its name first, then the command. If it does not understand, it tilts its head. Voice is optional and still to be proven.
landing.feat.home.title: Home and routine
landing.feat.home.text: A bed is home. Dogs settle down step by step and greet you at the door. The world only lets you sleep through the night when your pets are asleep, and you can switch that off in the config.
landing.feat.stages.title: Life stages
landing.feat.stages.text: Puppy, adolescent, adult, senior. Age follows the days of your world, not the real clock.
landing.feat.wild.title: Wild friends
landing.feat.wild.text: Win a wild dog over with patience, no fighting needed. Or find an orphan puppy that needs looking after.
landing.feat.skills.title: Skills and mastery
landing.feat.skills.text: Combat, Exploration and Domestic skill trees. Practice makes it better, and skills only get rusty after a very long time unused.
landing.feat.safe.title: Safe and fair
landing.feat.safe.text: Difficulty decides whether a dog can be lost for good: it gets knocked out first and you get a window to rescue it (Hardcore has no second chance). No chores, ever.
landing.feat.cats.title: Cats, later
landing.feat.cats.text: Cats are planned for V2: independent, fond of naps and warm spots, and friendly on their own terms.
landing.demos.title: Concept demos
landing.demos.sub: Little toys to get a feel for the ideas. They are sketches, not the game.
landing.demos.coats.title: Coats and litters
landing.demos.coats.text: Pick parents and see the kind of coats a litter could have.
landing.demos.training.title: Teaching a cue
landing.demos.training.text: Practice a cue and see how learning might feel.
landing.demos.lifecycle.title: A life in days
landing.demos.lifecycle.text: Watch the life stages go by as world days pass.
landing.demos.bond.title: A growing bond
landing.demos.bond.text: See how doing things together could build trust.

landing.stages.title: Meet the life stages
landing.stages.sub: Four ages, drawn as little pixel dogs. Age follows the days of your world.
landing.stages.puppy.name: Puppy
landing.stages.puppy.text: Small and curious. Tires out fast, recharges fast, and hates being alone.
landing.stages.adolescent.name: Adolescent
landing.stages.adolescent.text: Lanky, with a big pool of energy and the odd case of the zoomies.
landing.stages.adult.name: Adult
landing.stages.adult.text: Steady and capable. Old enough to have litters of its own.
landing.stages.senior.name: Senior
landing.stages.senior.text: A grey muzzle and a smaller energy pool. Slower, but still your dog.
landing.stages.art.puppy: Pixel art of a puppy: small body, big head, floppy ears.
landing.stages.art.adolescent: Pixel art of a lanky adolescent dog with upright ears.
landing.stages.art.adult: Pixel art of a grown dog sitting with a red collar.
landing.stages.art.senior: Pixel art of an older dog with a grey muzzle.
landing.road.title: Roadmap
landing.road.sub: Drawn from the project's public status file, so it cannot drift from the facts.
landing.road.failed: The roadmap could not load. See the project on GitHub for the current status.
landing.road.v0.name: V0 — Foundations
landing.road.v0.summary: Prove the toolchain and the hardest unknowns before building features.
landing.road.v1.name: V1 — The Dog
landing.road.v1.summary: Singleplayer dog: judgment, needs, genetics, training by cues, wild conquest, orphan puppies, sleep and home.
landing.road.v2.name: V2 — The Cat
landing.road.v2.summary: Independent cats with affection, naps, warm spots and their own life.
landing.road.v3.name: V3 — Multiplayer
landing.road.v3.summary: Bond per person, co-guardians, anti-theft rules.
landing.insp.title: Inspiration
landing.insp.sub: Ideas borrowed with respect. Text only: no footage or art from these works is used here.
landing.insp.ddog.title: D-Dog (Metal Gear Solid V)
landing.insp.ddog.text: Doing things together raises the bond, and the bond unlocks what your companion will do for you.
landing.insp.sam.title: Sam (I Am Legend)
landing.insp.sam.text: Shared routines and quiet presence: waiting at the door, small reactions that make a home feel lived in.
landing.insp.togo.title: Togo
landing.insp.togo.text: A hard-to-handle puppy who turns out to be a natural leader. A strong temperament is potential, not a flaw.
landing.insp.wolves.title: Real wolf packs
landing.insp.wolves.text: A wolf pack is a family, not a ladder of alphas. Leadership grows from care and experience.
landing.faq.title: Questions
landing.faq.a1: There is no release date. The project is in pre-alpha and nothing is playable yet. Watch the GitHub page for news.
landing.faq.a2: The target is {version}. That is a plan, and it can change.
landing.faq.a3: No. Voice is optional and only planned if it proves to work well. Chat words and keys will always work.
landing.faq.a4: Singleplayer comes first. Multiplayer is planned for V3.
landing.faq.a5: That is the plan: it is free software under {license}.
landing.faq.a6: It depends on the difficulty. A dog is knocked out first and you get a rescue window whose length depends on the difficulty. Hardcore has no second chance. The exact numbers are still being tuned, and the spec has the details.
landing.faq.a7: No. Smart Pets is an independent fan-made concept, not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. Minecraft is their trademark.
